meta.name: parasite-seo
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "rank on a high-authority third-party site" or "borrow domain authority"; plans distributed-authority (barnacle) publishing on Medium/Reddit/LinkedIn/Quora/GitHub that points back to the canonical site. Not for on-site page SEO — use on-page-seo-auditor; not for answer-engine citation tuning of your own page — use geo-content-optimizer. 寄生SEO/借势权重/第三方平台发布/分布式权威

copy.tagline: 在第三方高权重平台发布内容，借势提升自身网站排名
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望通过在Medium、Reddit等平台发布内容来提升网站权威度
copy.tagline_en: Publish on high-authority third-party sites to boost your own rankings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to leverage Medium, Reddit, and other platforms to improve your site's authority

howto.what: 这个技能会帮你制定在Medium、Reddit等第三方高权重平台发布内容的计划，让这些平台上的文章链接回你自己的网站，从而借用它们的权威来提升你网站的排名。
howto.when: 当你要求“在第三方高权重平台排名”或“借用域名权威”，或者提到寄生SEO、借势平台权重等关键词时触发。

say.text: 我网站没有域名权威，推荐几个第三方平台发布内容来快速获得引用。
say.note: 技能会按意图和受众推荐平台并说明理由。
